reviewMethod: Actually independently read all 175 English/Chinese pairs and their complete frozen published meaning/POS, variants and lexical evidence definitions in untruncated review ranges 0-60, 60-120 and 120-175. Separately read all 200 candidates' complete metadata, evidence IDs, lexical files, matched lemmas, match flags and ranks, and all 25 unretained candidates' full raw sources. Did not treat WordNet exact matches as approval: selected sand hopper follows the frozen mechanical sense; rose pink is the colour, silver bell the physical bell, sea snail the mollusc rather than the unrelated WordNet fish candidate. Independently opened/read relevant NASA PDF abstracts on pages 72/107 establishing SIRIS as scanning infrared inspection system for adhesive-bonded aerospace panel components, Kew's Liquidambar styraciflua description/common names supporting satin walnut as the tree, and Collins's sea swallow dialectal petrel and sea wolf wolffish senses. Preserved original fully read TSV in qa/c-review-p003-original.tsv, SHA adf16d77e1b555ee78dfbcbc36d184de701e8a7f0c1b4db90f86e0c95c7e6d3d. After author revision, actually reread all six final complete pairs plus full frozen source for sacred mushroom, sand sole, scale moss, sea creature, sea tangle and secretary bird. Verified exact six changes, all other 169 complete lines unchanged, every term/POS/selected meaning unchanged, all 175 rows and order preserved. New raw TSV SHA 14a10d8520f45bae55f43d12d22b3f7d17ea93029f1141053e702449ae279e59 matches the author's ready LOCK. Fresh compiled source entries were verified identical to that final TSV. No known blocking language, POS, sense or translation issue remains in the fully read final 175 rows.
